subject: Business Models
title: Digital Twins for Commerce
description: A 60-second lesson on Digital Twins for Commerce.

hook.text: Nike sells virtual sneakers for avatars. A digital twin of a product exists alongside the physical one.

buildup.text: Digital twins are virtual replicas of physical products, buildings, or systems that mirror real-world behavior.

discovery.text: BMW creates digital twins of entire factories. Changes are tested virtually before being implemented physically.

twist.text: For consumers, digital twins blur physical and virtual commerce. Your avatar wears digital Gucci in the metaverse.

climax.text: Digital twins create new revenue streams: sell the physical product once, sell the digital version infinitely.

punchline.text: One shoe, two sales: physical and digital. Twins double the revenue opportunity.

quiz.question: How do digital twins create new revenue for consumer brands?
options: Selling virtual versions of physical products as additional revenue streams

details.summary: Digital twins are virtual replicas of physical products, stores, factories, and supply chains that enable real-time monitoring, simulation, and optimization..
details.whyItMatters: Digital twins allow businesses to test changes virtually before implementing them physically, reducing risk and cost dramatically..
takeaways: Virtual replicas of physical assets enable simulation before real-world changes
IoT sensors provide real-time data that keeps digital twins accurate
Testing changes virtually reduces risk, cost, and implementation time

faq.question: How do digital twins improve business operations?
faq.answer: A factory digital twin predicts equipment failures before they cause downtime. A retail digital twin tests store layout changes on customer flow simulations. A supply chain digital twin models disruption scenarios and optimizes inventory positioning..

faq.question: What technology enables digital twins at commercial scale?
faq.answer: IoT sensors provide real-time data from physical assets. Cloud computing powers the processing of continuous data streams. AI and machine learning enable predictive capabilities. 3D modeling creates visual representations. 5G connectivity enables real-time data transmission from remote sensors.
